scope: All STAM spaces and all scene UI, including bottom bars
rule: Enter from the nearest scene wall or viewport edge; exit toward the same wall along the reverse path. No stationary pop-in or pop-out.
grouping: Keep each place marker, leader line, name and description together. Keep panel content attached to its panel.
lifecycle: Keep outgoing UI mounted until transform transition completes; disable interaction while closed. Reverse continuously when interrupted.
implementationStatus: Isolated motion preview prepared; application-wide runtime integration pending. Feature checkout unchanged.
